docText:
Lone Pine County Family Services
88 Mesquite Road, Lone Pine, Texas 79000

NOTICE OF CHANGE IN SNAP BENEFITS
Date mailed: October 23, 2026
Case: 7720-4418

Dear Household Member,

Your SNAP benefits will be reduced from $412 to $186 per month beginning December 1, 2026.

This change is due to an update in your household income.

You have the right to request a fair hearing if you disagree with this decision.

You may also contact your caseworker with questions.

Lone Pine County Family Services

reply:
[DATE]

To: [NAME OF AGENCY CONTACT]
Re: Request for fair hearing and continued benefits — Case [CASE NUMBER]

My name is [YOUR NAME]. My household received the notice dated October 23, 2026 about our SNAP benefits.

The notice states: "Your SNAP benefits will be reduced from $412 to $186 per month beginning December 1, 2026."

We disagree with this action and we are requesting a fair hearing.
We request that our benefits continue at the current level while the hearing is pending, as provided in 7 CFR 273.15(k)(1).
I am sending this request before Monday, November 30, 2026.

The notice does not fully include information that federal rules require it to contain. Please provide, in writing:
  • the telephone number of the SNAP office and, if possible, the name of a person to contact (7 CFR 273.13(a)(2))
  • an explanation of the availability of continued benefits (7 CFR 273.13(a)(2))
  • an explanation of my household's liability for overissuances received while awaiting a fair hearing (7 CFR 273.13(a)(2))

Please confirm receipt of this request in writing. You can reach me at [YOUR PHONE OR EMAIL].

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
